title: Fleet health
description: Replicas, GPU state, serving, throughput and goodput of the vllm-gpu serving fleet, Karpenter's scaling, GPU spend and the cost scoreboard (ADR-0026, "Panels"). Each GPU, serving, throughput and goodput panel shows the fleet aggregate beside a per-pod breakdown.

list.name: Node created
list.expr: sum((increase(karpenter_nodes_created_total[2m]) and karpenter_nodes_created_total offset 2m) or (karpenter_nodes_created_total unless karpenter_nodes_created_total offset 2m)) > 0

list.name: Node terminated
list.expr: sum((increase(karpenter_nodes_terminated_total[2m]) and karpenter_nodes_terminated_total offset 2m) or (karpenter_nodes_terminated_total unless karpenter_nodes_terminated_total offset 2m)) > 0

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: vllm-gpu replicas available against desired, from kube-state-metrics.

panels.title: GPU busy time
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL: the share of time a kernel was running on the GPU, averaged over the GPUs slipstream pods hold, fleet-wide and per pod. It is near 100% whenever any request is in flight, so it shows idle against serving, not how much load.

panels.title: GPU memory-bandwidth active
panels.description: DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE: the share of cycles the device memory interface was busy, averaged over the GPUs slipstream pods hold, fleet-wide and per pod. Each decode step reads the model weights and every running sequence's KV cache. Batching shares the weight reads, so with short contexts this falls as concurrency rises, and it climbs as long contexts fill the KV cache.

panels.title: KV-cache usage
panels.description: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc: the share of each replica's KV-cache blocks in use, averaged over the replicas fleet-wide, and per pod. Near 1, new requests wait for blocks and running ones can be preempted.

panels.title: Requests waiting
panels.description: vllm:num_requests_waiting: requests queued for the scheduler, not yet running, fleet-wide and per pod.

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: p95 time to first token from vLLM's histogram, fleet-wide and per pod. Goodput's TTFT gate is 1 s. vLLM's histograms carry no exemplars; the Requests over the TTFT gate table lists the slow requests by request_id.

panels.title: E2E latency p95
panels.description: p95 end-to-end latency of vLLM's llm_request spans, from the Collector's span metrics, fleet-wide and per pod. Exemplars on the fleet line open the trace, which carries the request_id. The p95 is interpolated inside a latency bucket, so from 15 s to 120 s it can be off by up to a factor of 1.5. Span metrics flush once a minute.

panels.title: Output tokens/s
panels.description: vllm:generation_tokens_total: tokens generated per second, fleet-wide and per pod.

panels.title: Prompt tokens/s
panels.description: vllm:prompt_tokens_total: prompt tokens processed per second, fleet-wide and per pod.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: vllm:request_success_total: requests finished per second, for any finish reason, fleet-wide and per pod.

panels.title: Live goodput
panels.description: The share of vLLM's llm_request spans whose request met the SLO (TTFT <= 1 s and TPOT <= 50 ms, the bench configs' goodput gates), from the Collector's span metrics split by slo_met, fleet-wide and per pod. It reads as the bench report's goodput_fraction. Span metrics flush once a minute; with no requests in the window it shows no data, and with none meeting the SLO, 0.

targets.expr: (sum by (k8s_pod_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="vllm", span_name="llm_request", slo_met="true"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (k8s_pod_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="vllm", span_name="llm_request"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (k8s_pod_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="vllm", span_name="llm_request"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests over the TTFT gate
panels.description: vLLM's llm_request spans whose TTFT exceeded goodput's 1 s gate, by request_id, sorted slowest first. A Tempo trace search returns the first 100 matching traces in the window, one request each, not the 100 slowest. Select a row's trace to open it. If it is empty while TTFT p95 is over 1 s, ttft_ms is missing from Tempo's spans or the query's literal does not match its type.

defaults.noValue: No llm_request span over the 1 s TTFT gate in Tempo

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: karpenter_cluster_state_node_count: the nodes in Karpenter's cluster state, the system node included. Annotations mark the minutes Karpenter created (green) or terminated (red) a node, from karpenter_nodes_created_total and karpenter_nodes_terminated_total. Karpenter creates those counters at their first increment, so a counter appearing marks one too.

panels.title: Pod-provisioning cold start
panels.description: p50 and p95 over the dashboard's time range of karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds: from when Karpenter's scheduling simulation last started placing a pending pod until the pod is running, so a GPU pod's figure includes launching its node. A simulation that finds no capacity for the pod restarts that clock, so time spent waiting out capacity shortages before the last attempt is left out. Karpenter creates the histogram at its first observation, so a series that starts inside the range counts in full. The quantiles are interpolated inside Karpenter's buckets, which from 150 s to 300 s are 2x wide.

defaults.noValue: No pod provisioned in the range

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) ((increase(karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]) and karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket offset $__range) or (last_over_time(karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]) unless karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket offset $__range)))) >= 0

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((increase(karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]) and karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket offset $__range) or (last_over_time(karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]) unless karpenter_pods_provisioning_startup_duration_seconds_bucket offset $__range)))) >= 0

panels.title: Voluntary disruptions by reason
panels.description: karpenter_voluntary_disruption_decisions_total over the dashboard's time range, by reason: the decisions Karpenter made to delete or replace nodes because they were empty, underutilized or drifted. Karpenter creates each reason's counter at its first decision, so a counter that starts inside the range counts in full.

defaults.noValue: No disruption decision in the range

targets.expr: sum by (reason) ((increase(karpenter_voluntary_disruption_decisions_total[$__range]) and karpenter_voluntary_disruption_decisions_total offset $__range) or (last_over_time(karpenter_voluntary_disruption_decisions_total[$__range]) unless karpenter_voluntary_disruption_decisions_total offset $__range))

panels.title: GPU vCPUs running (spend)
panels.description: CloudWatch AWS/Usage ResourceCount for the account's running on-demand G-class vCPUs (Class G/OnDemand), the series the spend-leak alarm watches; a g5.xlarge is 4. It is read from AWS, not the cluster, so it stays at 0 while the cluster is down and keeps the history from before a teardown. AWS publishes a datapoint every 5 minutes while any run and none while none do, so the panel reads 5-minute periods and FILL shows the empty ones as 0.

panels.title: $ per 1M tokens
panels.description: GPU dollars over the dashboard's time range, summed over every GPU node, divided by the prompt plus generation tokens served in that range, summed over every replica, times 1e6. Each minute a node holds a GPU it costs karpenter_cloudprovider_instance_type_offering_price_estimate for its instance type, capacity type and zone, divided by 60, so idle GPU time counts and the figure is what serving cost. There is no commercial arm and no input:output split.

defaults.noValue: No GPU node or no tokens served in the range

targets.expr: (sum_over_time(sum(count by (instance_type, capacity_type, zone) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{resource_type="nvidia.com/gpu"} > 0) * on (instance_type, capacity_type, zone) max by (instance_type, capacity_type, zone) (karpenter_cloudprovider_instance_type_offering_price_estimate))[$__range:1m]) / 60) / ((sum(increase(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{namespace="slipstream"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total{namespace="slipstream"}[$__range]))) > 0) * 1e6

panels.title: Tokens/s per $/h
panels.description: Prompt plus generation tokens served per second over the dashboard's time range, divided by the GPU dollars per hour over the same range, from the same tokens and GPU dollars as $ per 1M tokens: the throughput each dollar an hour of GPU buys, idle GPU time included.

defaults.noValue: No GPU node or no tokens served in the range

targets.expr: (sum(increase(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{namespace="slipstream"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(vllm:generation_tokens_total{namespace="slipstream"}[$__range]))) / (3600 * (sum_over_time(sum(count by (instance_type, capacity_type, zone) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{resource_type="nvidia.com/gpu"} > 0) * on (instance_type, capacity_type, zone) max by (instance_type, capacity_type, zone) (karpenter_cloudprovider_instance_type_offering_price_estimate))[$__range:1m]) / 60))
